21.text: SHAMANISTIC GARMENTS. — The shamanism of the Chukchee has not

22.text: reached a stage of development high enough to have drums or clothing of

23.text: peculiar form, or, indeed, any special belongings characteristic of itself. The

24.text: Chukchee shaman uses the ordinary drum of his family, or perhaps he may

25.text: make an extra drum for his own use; but this drum will have exactly the

26.text: same form, and, moreover, it will probably be employed in all the family

27.text: ceremonials, where additional drums are used for making as much noise as
